rows.name: Hook window audio onset
rows.detail: Onset at 0:08, after the hook window

rows.name: Safe-zone overlap across full runtime
rows.detail: At 0:01–0:04 the headline "Smart saving, sweet rewards." sits in the upper third but disclaimer text at 0:02–0:04 is placed just above the bottom third (~75–80% down), close to the bottom 20% exclusion zone, and at 0:06–0:08 the "5.10% p.a" block and disclaimer text run from ~25% to ~75% height, with disclaimer text extending into the bottom ~20% safe zone boundary.

panel.caption: Safe-zone map · where the on-screen text lands
panel.note: The disclaimer text overlaps the bottom exclusion zone in both windows shown — the band most apps reserve for captions and UI controls.

rows.name: Cut frequency vs platform pacing
rows.detail: Only one hard cut is visible, at 0:05 (solid color transition frame) separating the candy-jar scene (0:00–0:04) from the end-card (0:06–0:08); for an 8.3s vertical ad this is a single transition, slower than the typical 2–3 cuts recommended for short-form pacing.

rows.name: Hook window motion detected
rows.detail: Frames 0:00–0:03 show a hand actively moving into the candy bowl, fingers shifting position between frames, indicating continuous motion in the first four seconds.

rows.name: Hook window face detected
rows.detail: A blurred, out-of-focus partial face is visible in the background at 0:00–0:03 but it is not in focus or centered, so it's only weakly detectable.

rows.name: Hook window text on screen
rows.detail: Text "Smart saving, sweet rewards." appears by 0:01 and remains through 0:03, well within the four-second hook window.

rows.name: On-screen text coverage
rows.detail: At 0:02–0:04 three text blocks (headline plus legal disclaimer) are stacked simultaneously, and at 0:06–0:08 the end card has headline, subhead, disclaimer and CTA button all visible at once, covering roughly 40–50% of vertical frame space.

rows.name: Product first appearance
rows.detail: The actual product (IMB Bank term deposit / logo) does not appear until the end card at 0:06; the first six seconds show only a candy-bowl metaphor with no bank branding or product visual.

rows.name: Product visible duration
rows.detail: Bank logo and product name ("imb bank", "6 month Term Deposit") are only visible from 0:06 to 0:08 — roughly 2.3 seconds out of 8.3 total runtime (~28%).

rows.name: Message clarity in hook window
rows.detail: By 0:01–0:03 the tagline "Smart saving, sweet rewards." conveys a savings theme, but no specific product, rate or bank name is shown until 0:06, so the core offer is unclear in the hook window.

rows.name: Native feel vs polished ad
rows.detail: The candy-bowl lifestyle footage (0:00–0:04) has a native, UGC-like handheld feel, but the abrupt cut to a highly designed, branded end card at 0:06–0:08 breaks the native illusion partway through.

rows.name: Text legibility & hold time
rows.detail: The "5.10% p.a" rate text and "OPEN ONLINE" CTA at 0:06–0:08 use high-contrast neon green on a dark teal background and hold for roughly two-plus seconds each, making them easily legible.

rows.name: Sound-off redundancy
rows.detail: Audio onset is at 0:08, meaning the first eight seconds — the entire hook window and offer explanation — carry no audio cue and no captions restating the spoken content, relying solely on on-screen text.

findings.title: Product first appearance
findings.detail: At 0:00 the frame shows only a hand reaching into a candy bowl with no bank product, logo, or brand cue present.

findings.title: Hook window text on screen
findings.detail: By 0:01 the headline "Smart saving, sweet rewards." appears in bold white and green text within the first second of the hook window.

findings.title: On-screen text coverage
findings.detail: At 0:02 three separate text elements (headline plus a dense legal disclaimer block) are stacked on screen simultaneously, increasing visual clutter.

findings.title: Cut frequency vs platform pacing
findings.detail: At 0:05 the video cuts to a flat two-color transition frame, marking the only major scene cut in the entire 8.3-second runtime.

findings.title: Product visible duration
findings.detail: The IMB Bank logo and "5.10% p.a, 6 month Term Deposit" offer first appear at 0:06, leaving only ~2.3 seconds for product and brand visibility.

findings.title: Sound-off redundancy
findings.detail: Audio onset occurs at 0:08, the very end of the video, meaning virtually the entire ad plays silently with no synced narration to reinforce the text.

findings.title: Text legibility & hold time
findings.detail: At 0:08 the CTA "OPEN ONLINE" button uses high-contrast neon green against dark teal, remaining legible and held steady through the final frame.

top_fix.headline: Move the bank logo, product name, and rate into the first 2–3 seconds instead of withholding them until 0:06.
top_fix.body: Currently the entire hook window (0–4s) is a generic candy-bowl metaphor with zero brand or product cues, so viewers who drop off before six seconds never see what's being advertised. Front-loading the "5.10% p.a" Term Deposit offer and the IMB Bank logo would fix the three checks below simultaneously.
